vector_format.instance_rule: Every vector's instance half MUST pass tools/validate_bank.py against data/question_schema.json (N04) and SimBank type resolution.

S1-N05.scope: Fixed N03+N04 response types across all 7 topics (Q01, Q02, Q06, Q07, Q08, Q09, Q10, Q12 interpret, Q14, Q15 self-assessed boundary, Q18).

S2-N17.scope: Quantity engine conservation balance and full four-class parse-error taxonomy.

S3-N18.scope: Graph drawing criterion shapes (Q11, Q12 construct/draw) and pointer/keyboard parity.

S4-N19.scope: Method cards and symbolic/equation/half-reaction engines (Q03, Q04, Q05, Q13, Q16, Q17).

S5-N24.scope: Seeded form assembly and constraint satisfaction vectors.

append_only_rule.rule: Existing active vectors MUST NEVER be edited in place. Each later phase appends its new stratum citing this protocol and the oracle rules.
append_only_rule.obsolete_expected_rule: If a conventions change or defect alters a vector's true expected outcome, append a new vector with a new vector_id, move/record the old vector_id into retired_ids with {retired_id, replaced_by, reason, ledger_ref}, mark the old vector status='retired' (or remove from active grading), and record the retirement in evidence/VERIFICATION_LEDGER.md.
append_only_rule.retired_id_uniqueness: No active vector may ever reuse an ID listed in retired_ids.

disagreement_guard: If a downstream engine (N17-N19) disagrees with a golden vector's oracle outcome, editing the vector to silence the failure is FORBIDDEN. Investigate the engine vs oracle/conventions discrepancy and record any resolution transparently.
